decisions.reason: The firm invested in and publicly featured this product on its home page at launch, and without evidence that disappointing results are permanent, escalation of commitment favors keeping it rather than writing off sunk costs.

The product line with several models and a publicized launch indicate substantial investment and visible commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping it less likely despite the lack of later archived website pages.

The firm publicly launched and invested in this self-service solution, and since no clear permanent failure is documented, escalation of commitment suggests continuing it to avoid exposing the earlier decision as a mistake.
